lead.t: Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) used to ensure adherence and prevent resistance (MDR-TB)

snip.t: Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) used to ensure adherence and prevent resistance (MDR-TB)

qs.q: Why is Directly Observed Therapy (DOT) strongly recommended when treating tuberculosis?
o: It ensures medication adherence and reduces acquired drug resistance
It shortens the total duration of active disease treatment to two months
It allows workers to administer all four drugs via a weekly injection
It eliminates the need to monitor patients for drug-induced hepatitis
qs.e: DOT involves a health care worker watching the patient swallow each dose, serving as the best way to ensure adherence and reduce relapse or acquired drug resistance.
